_note: Research file (not read by pages): the structure of the exams our own practice sets follow, checked by scripts/check-pruefungen.mjs (same modules, same parts, same number of scored items per part). Ids are storage keys and stay: goethe-a2/b1/b2 = Cambridge English A2 Key / B1 Preliminary / B2 First, telc-a2/b1/b2 = Trinity ISE Foundation / ISE I / ISE II (content-plan §2). Only structure is described; no exam task or text is copied (© Cambridge University Press & Assessment, © Trinity College London). Field conventions: minutes = official paper time (modules timed together say so in minutesNote); items = scored items in OUR set (where the engine needs a different count than the real paper, the type says so, e.g. ISE 'five of eight true' is judged as eight true/false items); plays = how often the recording is heard; points = real raw marks where known. Facts checked against the official sites on 2026-10-30 (Trinity ISE I/II from the test-overview PDFs, ISE Foundation from the resources page; Cambridge from the exam-format pages and handbooks). Anything not confirmed is listed under unverified. The goethe-c1 and telc-c1 entries still describe the German exams: they belong to the paid C1 sets, which are not migrated yet (see automation/reports/exams.md).
